text:
They must have shown you—mocking,

delight of your friends, thief of hearts,

the naughtiest girl in Pushkin's town—

this photograph of your calamitous years,

how you stand beside a hostile wall,

among three hundred ragged ones in line,

taking a ration in your hand

and the New Year's ice reduced to embers by your tears.

Look at the prison poplar bending!

No noise. Not a sound. Even so, how many

innocent lives are ending.

translation.title: They Must Have Shown You—Mocking
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the contrast between youthful mockery and the prison-line photograph.
